main_measure.name: OLS slope of 20-bar excess return on forecast (positive-forecast grid bars)
main_measure.threshold: slope t >= +2 with >= 100 cases to confirm (with top-minus-bottom third > 0); t <= -2 with >= 100 cases to reject

supporting_check.name: top-third minus bottom-third mean excess return

decided_by: Fewer than 100 positive-forecast grid cases (47), so the minimum count is not reached.
reading: The coin's mean 20-bar return is taken over all its grid bars (positions 0, 20, 40, ... of each window) in all windows; thirds are the floor(n/3) lowest and highest forecasts after a stable sort; fewer than 100 cases is reported as not observable per the minimum-count rule.
